title: First live no-spend API-vs-RunPod quote (roadmap acceptance 3, smoke test)
summary: `orchestrate quote --gpu-from runpod` on 2026-09-29 against RunPod's live public gpuTypes inventory (23 offers with >= 80 GB VRAM). Workload: private batch inference, 20,000 items x (2,000 input + 800 output tokens), vram_gb 80. LIVE: GPU prices (A100 PCIe community $1.19/h, A100 SXM community $1.39/h, A100 PCIe secure $1.59/h). ASSUMED (operator inputs, not measured): API option at $3/$15 per Mtok; 1,500 generated tokens/s aggregate for a batched vLLM server on one A100 80GB; prefill weight 0.1; default 8 min startup + 10 min idle; failure rates API 0.05, GPU 0.10. Result: A100 PCIe community expected $5.25 (low $4.03, high $7.70, 4.4 billed h) vs API expected $378.95; recommended GPU pod; saving $373.69 expected. Every option's budget gate returned requires_approval (budget not approved), and sensitivity=private produced routing requirements deployment in {local, gpu_pod, serverless}. Nothing was provisioned. The magnitude depends almost entirely on the assumed throughput; a measured vLLM benchmark for the chosen model must replace it before a paid run.
